title: nBootstrap: Nonparametric Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
text: Nonparametric bootstrap helpers R (R Core Team, 2026): percentile, bias-corrected, bias-corrected accelerated confidence intervals matrix draws, nonparametric bootstrap jackknife half-vectorized covariance matrices computed C++. functions internal; projects copy .

title: nBootstrap: Nonparametric Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
text: can install development version nBootstrap GitHub :

title: nBootstrap: Nonparametric Bootstrap Confidence Intervals
text: functions internal. Bootstrap draws half-vectorized covariance matrix. Percentile confidence intervals every column draws.
code: set.seed(seed = 42) x <- as.matrix(x = datasets::mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt")]) draws <- nBootstrap:::.NBVechCovDraws(x = x, R = 1000L) dim(x = draws) #> [1] 1000    3 theta_hat <- c(stats::cov(x = x))[c(1, 2, 4)] names(x = theta_hat) <- c("var_mpg", "cov", "var_wt") colnames(x = draws) <- names(x = theta_hat) nBootstrap:::.CIMat(   thetahatstar = draws,   thetahat = theta_hat,   alpha = c(0.05, 0.01),   type = "pc" ) #>               est        se    R       0.5%       2.5%     97.5%     99.5% #> var_mpg 36.324103 8.2878501 1000 15.6449379 20.4642755 52.335445 56.567037 #> cov     -5.116685 1.1974755 1000 -8.1858457 -7.5797050 -2.761651 -2.235399 #> var_wt   0.957379 0.2412427 1000  0.4045389  0.4841965  1.418687  1.597035

title: Bias-Corrected Confidence Intervals — BCCI
text: Returns bias-corrected confidence intervals draws nonparametric bootstrap: quantiles draws \(\Phi \left( 2 \hat{z}_{0} + z_{p} \right)\), \(\hat{z}_{0} = \Phi^{-1} \left( \# \{ \hat{\theta}^{*} < \hat{\theta} \} / R \right)\) \(z_{p}\) standard normal quantile limit.

title: Bias-Corrected Confidence Intervals — BCCI
text: thetahatstar Numeric matrix. Sampling distribution: one row per draw, one column per parameter. numeric vector taken one parameter. Missing draws (NA) dropped, parameter parameter. thetahat Numeric vector. Parameter estimates, one per column thetahatstar. names name rows result. alpha Numeric vector. Significance levels \(\alpha\).

title: Bias-Corrected Confidence Intervals — BCCI
text: Returns numeric matrix one row per parameter: estimate (est), standard deviation draws (se), number draws used (R), confidence limits.

title: Bias-Corrected Confidence Intervals — BCCI
code: set.seed(seed = 42) x <- matrix(data = rnorm(n = 200), ncol = 2) thetahat <- c(m1 = mean(x = x[, 1]), m2 = mean(x = x[, 2])) thetahatstar <- t(   x = replicate(     n = 1000,     expr = colMeans(x = x[sample.int(n = 100, replace = TRUE), ])   ) ) BCCI(   thetahatstar = thetahatstar,   thetahat = thetahat,   alpha = 0.05 ) #>            est         se    R       2.5%      97.5% #> m1  0.03251482 0.10589716 1000 -0.1696175 0.23621851 #> m2 -0.08748371 0.08960159 1000 -0.2626150 0.08867087

what: Bias-Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals — BCaCI
title: Bias-Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals — BCaCI
text: Returns bias-corrected accelerated confidence intervals draws nonparametric bootstrap: quantiles draws \(\Phi \left( \hat{z}_{0} + \frac{\hat{z}_{0} + z_{p}}{1 - \hat{} \left( \hat{z}_{0} + z_{p} \right)} \right)\), acceleration \(\hat{}\) jackknife estimates.

title: Bias-Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals — BCaCI
Bias-Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals — BCaCI
text: thetahatstar Numeric matrix. Sampling distribution: one row per draw, one column per parameter. numeric vector taken one parameter. Missing draws (NA) dropped, parameter parameter. thetahat Numeric vector. Parameter estimates, one per column thetahatstar. names name rows result. jackknife Numeric matrix. Jackknife estimates: one row per left-case, one column per parameter. alpha Numeric vector. Significance levels \(\alpha\).

title: Bias-Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals — BCaCI
text: Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

title: Bias-Corrected and Accelerated Confidence Intervals — BCaCI
code: set.seed(seed = 42) x <- matrix(data = rnorm(n = 200), ncol = 2) thetahat <- c(m1 = mean(x = x[, 1]), m2 = mean(x = x[, 2])) thetahatstar <- t(   x = replicate(     n = 1000,     expr = colMeans(x = x[sample.int(n = 100, replace = TRUE), ])   ) ) jackknife <- t(   x = vapply(     X = 1:100,     FUN = function(i) colMeans(x = x[-i, ]),     FUN.VALUE = numeric(length = 2)   ) ) BCaCI(   thetahatstar = thetahatstar,   thetahat = thetahat,   jackknife = jackknife,   alpha = 0.05 ) #>            est         se    R       2.5%      97.5% #> m1  0.03251482 0.10589716 1000 -0.1713847 0.23171352 #> m2 -0.08748371 0.08960159 1000 -0.2609704 0.09348249
